events.event: Golkar chair Bahlil Lahadalia said DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad is among the preferences to replace Gibran as vice president, and that Prabowo will meet coalition party chairs (Gerindra, Golkar, PAN, Demokrat) at Hambalang before 25 November to prepare two names for the MPR.
events.key_numbers: 2 names to MPR · meeting before 25 Nov 2026 · 4 coalition parties · MPR plenary 9 Dec 2026 (per storyline)
events.why_it_matters: Decides who becomes the next vice president and when the names reach the MPR.
events.spreading_evidence: Detik, Antara, Viva, Okezone all carried it on 22 Nov; Antara politik page dominated by Dasco-for-VP items

events.event: PAN, Sandiaga Uno, Wali Nanggroe Aceh, 98 activists and Sulsel academics publicly backed Gerindra figure Dasco as vice president, while Gerindra-aligned figure Bawono called allegations against Dasco baseless.
events.key_numbers: 5+ backers named in Antara headlines 22 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Shows how fast a single name is consolidating before the MPR vote.
events.spreading_evidence: Seven Dasco items in ANTARA politik top 30 on 22 Nov

events.event: DPD chair Sultan Bachtiar Najamudin proposed that Indonesia have more than one vice president (Kompas headline says three), saying the idea dates from 2019, is not for now and needs a constitutional process.
events.key_numbers: 3 VPs (per Kompas headline) · idea first voiced 2019 · not for current vacancy
events.why_it_matters: A surprising constitutional idea surfacing while the VP seat is empty.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by Kompas, Detik, CNN, Jawa Pos, Viva, Sindonews

events.event: Polri announced Kapolri Telegram ST/2598/XI/KEP/2026 (dated 20 Nov) moving three senior officers who are suspects in the alleged wiretapping of the President (initials AS, EHS, SU) to Yanma Polri, as part of a rotation of 107 officers; Polri called it routine organisational dynamics.
events.key_numbers: 3 suspects moved to Yanma · 107 officers in telegram (Suara Surabaya; other outlets report different totals) · telegram dated 20 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Shows what happens to police generals under suspect status while the case continues.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA hukum #29, multiple outlets 22 Nov; PKS also demanded the 'user' be investigated (ANTARA 22 Nov)

events.event: Kapolda Bengkulu Irjen Yudhi Sulistianto Wahid, who knelt and apologised to Cipayung Plus students on 19 Nov, was replaced by Brigjen Augustinus Berlianto Pangaribuan in the same 20 Nov telegram; no official statement linked the move to the kneeling.
events.key_numbers: Kneeling 19 Nov · telegram 20 Nov · announced 22 Nov · deputy and 6 Kapolres also moved (headline)
events.why_it_matters: A viral apology followed by a transfer raises questions about how police leaders handle protests.

events.event: Kejagung said it will continue legal proceedings against Pertamina crude-oil governance suspect Riza Chalid, a fugitive abroad, including a trial in absentia once he is listed DPO and a red notice is filed; the death penalty option is being studied but depends on legal parameters.
events.key_numbers: 2 steps for in-absentia trial: DPO listing + Interpol red notice · death penalty option under study · no loss figure in the report
events.why_it_matters: Whether a fugitive can be tried and sentenced without showing up.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN nasional #4, ANTARA hukum #32 on 22 Nov

events.event: Immigration Director General Hendarsam Marantoko said two WNI suspected of being recruited as Russian mercenaries were stopped at Juanda Airport around 19-20 Nov, and immigration will screen passport applicants and step up cyber patrols.
events.key_numbers: 2 WNI stopped at Juanda · stopped ~2 days before 22 Nov statement
events.why_it_matters: Shows how Indonesians are lured abroad and what the state now checks at the passport counter.
events.spreading_evidence: Antara hukum #25; Republika, Jawa Pos, IDN Times

events.event: Ma'ruf Amin, the former vice president, stood by his resignation as Ketua Dewan Pertimbangan MUI despite MUI's request that he stay; Jimly Asshiddiqie, Afifuddin Muhajir and Zainut Tauhid are named as possible successors with a new chair expected around December 2026.
events.why_it_matters: Leadership change at the body that issues halal certification and fatwas.

events.event: DPR Deputy Speaker Dasco said he will consider legal action after his 17-year-old daughter was bullied on social media and pledged to speed up revision of the Child Protection Law; KPAI said parents' political differences must not make children targets.
events.key_numbers: Daughter aged 17 · statement 20 Nov · KPAI response 22 Nov
events.why_it_matters: A minor is caught in politics and it is pushing a child-protection law revision.
events.spreading_evidence: KPAI, BKPRMI, Wamen HAM statements 22 Nov
